faq.question: Which is the best construction company in Coimbatore?
faq.answer: Saanidhya Builders is consistently rated among the top construction companies in Coimbatore, with 15+ years of experience, 500+ completed projects, and a 4.9-star client rating. We specialise in residential and commercial construction, architectural design, and turnkey projects.

faq.question: How much does it cost to build a house in Coimbatore?
faq.answer: House construction costs in Coimbatore range from ₹1,800 to ₹3,500 per sq.ft depending on specification. Basic: ₹1,800–2,000/sq.ft. Standard: ₹2,200–2,600/sq.ft. Premium: ₹3,000–3,500+/sq.ft. Contact us for a detailed free estimate.

faq.question: Is Saanidhya Builders RERA registered?
faq.answer: Yes. Saanidhya Builders is RERA registered and complies with all Tamil Nadu RERA regulations. We are also ISO certified and bank-approved, giving you complete peace of mind on every project.

faq.question: How much does residential construction cost in Coimbatore?
faq.answer: Residential construction in Coimbatore costs between ₹1,800 to ₹3,500 per sq.ft. Basic specification: ₹1,800–2,000/sq.ft. Standard: ₹2,200–2,600/sq.ft. Premium/luxury: ₹3,000–3,500+/sq.ft. Get a detailed free estimate from Saanidhya Builders.

faq.question: How long does it take to build a house in Coimbatore?
faq.answer: A typical 1,500–2,000 sq.ft residential home in Coimbatore takes 12–16 months to build. Larger villas may take 18–24 months. Saanidhya Builders provides a detailed construction schedule before starting and sends regular progress updates.

faq.question: Do you build Vastu-compliant homes in Coimbatore?
faq.answer: Yes. Saanidhya Builders designs all homes as per Vastu Shastra principles by default. Our architects are trained in Vastu-compliant layouts. We can also modify any floor plan to meet specific Vastu requirements.
